result.instructions: Tools for Assignar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders start this week, and which clients are they for?"; "Show the timesheets for last week that are not processed yet."; "Who is allocated to order 118 on 2 December?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Assignar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run assignar_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run assignar_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run assignar_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. assignar_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: assignar_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (jobs and bookings). Filter by client, status, dates or any field. GET /v2/orders.

page_size.description: Records per page. Empty uses the API default.

sort.description: Sort by top-level fields, comma-separated. Prefix a field with - for descending, e.g. -start_date.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. id,name.

filters.description: Field filters as name/value pairs, e.g. {"active":"true"}. Add an operator suffix for ranges or lists, e.g. start_date__gte, client_id__in.

tools.name: assignar_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a client (customer) in Assignar. Needs name and company_name. Writes live data. POST /v2/clients/.

external_id.description: Your own id for this client.

tools.name: assignar_create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: Create an order (a job or shift booking). Needs client_id, order_owner (a user id), start_date and end_date, as the API expects them (e.g. 2026-12-01). Writes live scheduling data. POST /v2/orders.

order_owner.description: User id of the person who owns the order (from assignar_list_users).

start_date.description: Start date, as the API expects it (e.g. 2026-12-01).

end_date.description: End date, as the API expects it (e.g. 2026-12-01).
